scope: Standalone native server and pinned upstream source. No model weights or application components.
platform: Linux x86-64, RTX 5090 32 GiB, CUDA 13.2; matching retained pinned-upstream CUDA libraries

checks.cpu_integrated_build: passed: server, generate, decode, quantize, audio join, visual parser, HTTP security, duplex and voice capture
checks.native_cpu_regressions: passed: concurrency, cancellation, lossless fragments, immutable heard prefixes, bounded queues, context ordering and long multimodal capture; exact optional quoted-history view, original history preservation and text-only validation
checks.http_authentication: passed: real upstream HTTP middleware and all 10 Omni routes; non-loopback startup without API key rejected
checks.pcm_example_client: passed: synthetic HTTP/SSE ordering, byte-exact PCM and failure cleanup
checks.upgrade_kit: applied to fresh pinned upstream; configured and built duplex/capture targets; both regressions passed
checks.cuda_module_build: passed; module rebuilt from public source and linked to retained matching upstream CUDA shared libraries, not a fresh rebuild of every CUDA dependency

scheduling.note: All completed pairs are included; the final batch also tests the new optional quoted-history view. Short fixed English passage, seed 42, 65K context allocation. Consumed-PCM ACKs, not device playback or broad quality qualification. An initially added adaptive test client acknowledged a phrase boundary before its PCM tail; the corrected client passed both subsequent full suites.

checks.source_scope: Allowlisted native module; full upstream history already public. Native source and documentation reviewed separately from secret scanning.

limitations: Native inference/session primitives only; conversational policy, capture, echo cancellation and playback belong to callers.
Measurements do not prove unchanged speed on every input or GPU; short-input concurrent tests do not qualify a near-full 65K multimodal context or 128K.
Smaller adaptive phrases can change prosody and seeded PCM relative to legacy segmentation; model precision was not reduced.
No broad perceptual, multilingual, Windows or other-GPU qualification. Historical BF16 input-specific stall and CUDA Xid 11 remain disclosed in the native validation files.
